title: Utility Order for L & R Utilities, Inc., ex parte. — Order No. U-37775 accepts the Uncontested Stipulated Settlement filed into the record on July 6, 2026. Commission consideration occurred at the August 12, 2026 Business and Executive Session.

II.         COMMISSION AUTHORITY



            The Commission exercises jurisdiction over public utilities in Louisiana pursuant to Article


IV, Section 21(B) of the Louisiana Constitution.



LA. Const. Art. IV, Sec. 21(B) provides in pertinent part:


            The commission shall regulate all common carries and public utilities and
            have such other regulatory authority as provided by law. It shall adopt and
            enforce reasonable    rules, regulations, and procedures necessary for the
            discharge of its duties, and shall have other powers and perform other duties
            as provided by law.
